description: This file defines configuration classes and related structures for a plugin system within the WPEFramework. It includes JSON serialization, configuration options, and system path utilities.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Main configuration class for the plugin, including nested classes for root configuration and system settings.

classes.name: Config::RootConfig
classes.description: Represents the root configuration options, including mode, locator, user, and remote address.

classes.name: Config::RootObject
classes.description: Internal class used for JSON parsing of configuration string.

classes.name: Config::Setting
classes.description: Utility class for logging configuration settings.

methods.name: Config::DataPath
methods.description: Constructs a data path based on the base path and class name.

methods.name: Config::PersistentPath
methods.description: Constructs a persistent storage path based on the base path and postfix.

methods.name: Config::VolatilePath
methods.description: Constructs a volatile storage path based on the base path and postfix.

methods.name: Config::IPV4UnicastNode
methods.description: Returns the NodeId for a given network interface name.

methods.name: Config::IsSameInstance
methods.description: Checks if another Config instance refers to the same system instance.
